name: Russia–Ukraine
summary: Russia launched a mass missile and drone attack early on 20 Nov after Putin vowed revenge for the Crimean Bridge strike
state: Russia launched a combined missile and drone attack early on 20 Nov; monitoring channels tracked about 50 missiles in the air at once, three people were killed in Kyiv and three city bridges were damaged (UNN, Kyiv Independent). Putin had vowed a more painful response after Ukraine's 17 Nov strike collapsed part of the Crimean Bridge. On 17 Nov local officials reported 14 killed and 78 injured across Ukraine in one day (Kyiv Independent). The UN human rights office said October civilian casualties were up 95% year on year (ISW, 18 Nov).
for_you: Civilians across Ukraine, including western regions, face repeated missile and drone strikes and power, heat and water outages. Check FCDO travel advice, which advises against all travel to Ukraine.
rubric_hit: Alert: mass-casualty strikes and significant escalation (about 50 missiles in one wave, 20 Nov; 14 killed in a day, 17 Nov)
